title: Refuse slice run briefs stored inside the slice worktree
body: Outcome: krn slice run refuses (exit 64, before the commit stage) a --brief or --message path inside the slice worktree, because landing hygiene removes that worktree and with it the lead brief, message and log (t-b1pxnvk: the brief dir vanished mid-run and a tail on its log read as a failure). Proof: a slice run test with a brief under .krn/worktrees/<name>/ exits 64 and names the path; a brief under the main checkout .krn/runs/lead/ is accepted.
